GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, slow into stride & Settled Down last but only trailing 6 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths turning, Made Ground 3 Wide through field in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly while being restrained early stages. Tactics queried. Rider advised he was given no firm instructions as it was first-up, it began only fairly from the Wide gate, and obliged to race Wide he elected to restrain and settle rearward. He added this was further back than expected but expressed overall satisfaction with the overall performance noting it will race better over further distance.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Shortly after the start was bumped. Raced keenly whilst being restrained in the early stages. Laid in when placed under pressure in the home straight. Tactics. Rdr explained that he was given no firm instructions as the gelding was first up from a spell. He added from the wide gate he began only fairly and was left in a position where he would be obliged to race wide, so elected to restrain his mount and settle toward the rear of the field. He further added that this was further back than expected but expressed satisfaction with the overall performance.
